hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); deny(){ printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"%s"}}' "$1"; exit 0; }; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '\bgit( +-C +[^ ]+)?( +-[A-Za-z]+)* +commit\b'; then case "$branch" in master|main) deny "You are on $branch. Create a feature branch first (git checkout -b feature/<name>) before committing.";; esac; fi; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '\bgit( +-C +[^ ]+)?( +-[A-Za-z]+)* +push\b'; then if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(:|[[:space:]])(master|main)\b'; then deny "That pushes directly to master/main. Push a feature branch and open a PR instead."; fi; rest=${cmd#*push}; positionals=$(echo "$rest" | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -vcE '^-|^$'); if [ "$positionals" -le 1 ]; then case "$branch" in master|main) deny "You are on $branch. Push a feature branch and open a PR instead.";; esac; fi; fi
